Henrik Rasmussen is a medical consultant ("Lægefaglig konsulent") who appears in the AFDK annual report as a substitute member ("suppleant") on the steering committee for DAK-E [^src1]. The report, covering the period from 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, lists the composition of the AFDK steering group as part of its chapter on the database's data foundation, patient population definitions, and data-collection limitations [^src1]. Beyond this single listing, no further details about his background, tenure, or activities are available in the corpus.
